integrity: The proof uses analytic implicit continuation, exact differentiated matrices and a Taylor expansion whose coefficients are given in RESULT.md. Direct reproducibility checks appear in verify_periodic_data.py. They supplement but do not replace the analytical proof. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The analytic coefficients and absence of a C^1 conjugacy are proved only for sufficiently small positive deformations along cos(alpha)=-mu; no explicit optimal cutoff or all-parameter classification. The existence of the underlying Anosov family, fixed-point formula and global conjugacy are credited to the cited source. Novelty is assessed against the inspected sources and searchable record and is not an independent priority certification.
title: Period-two spectral splitting on a fixed-point-blind Blaschke–Anosov curve
